intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Hiranyasaga Techsolutions Private Limited (“Company”, “we”, “us” or “our”) collects, uses, discloses, stores, protects and otherwise processes personal data in connection with Tazmify, including the Tazmify mobile application and website (collectively, the “Platform”).

blocks.text: Tazmify is a marketplace and collaboration platform through which brands and creators can discover one another, create or apply to influencer campaigns, communicate, exchange campaign materials, manage campaign activity and, where enabled, manage payments and payouts.
The Platform is operated by Hiranyasaga Techsolutions Private Limited, Building No. Ep-9/198, Eranholi, Kannur Thalassery, Kerala 670107, India.
For privacy-related questions, requests or complaints, please contact: contact@tazmify.com.

This Policy applies to personal data processed through the Tazmify Android application, the Tazmify website and related Platform features. It applies to both brands and creators and to visitors who interact with the Platform.
This Policy should be read together with Tazmify’s Terms of Use and any feature-specific notices or consent screens presented in the Platform.
3.1 Information you provide directly

items: Account and contact information, such as name, email address, mobile number, login credentials or authentication information and account identifiers.

Profile information, including profile photograph, biography, professional information, creator category/niche, location, portfolio, social-media identifiers or links, audience information, engagement information, rate card and other information you choose to publish.

Brand and campaign information, including campaign title, brief, niche, budget, deliverables, timeline, location, eligibility requirements, applications, shortlists, campaign status and related instructions.
Verification or KYC information, where a verification feature is used, including information reasonably required to verify an account or transaction.
Communication and user-content data, including messages, images, videos, documents, campaign materials, reviews, ratings, comments and other content submitted through the Platform.

Payment, billing and payout information, where payment or payout features are used, including transaction-related information and information required to process or reconcile payments. Payment credentials may be handled by third-party payment service providers rather than stored directly by Tazmify.
Information relating to Connects, credits, subscriptions, premium campaigns or other paid Platform features, where such features are enabled.
Information you provide when contacting customer support, reporting an issue or making a privacy or grievance request.

blocks.text: 3.2 Information collected automatically

items: Device and technical information, such as device model, operating system, app version, browser type, IP address, device identifiers where permitted, language, time zone and diagnostic information.
Usage information, such as pages or screens viewed, features used, searches, campaign interactions, clicks, session information and error logs.

Location information, including approximate or precise location where the relevant feature is enabled and the user grants the required permission. Location may be used for proximity-based discovery, matching, campaign eligibility and related Platform functionality.
Cookies, SDK-generated information and similar technologies used for authentication, security, analytics, preferences and Platform functionality, where applicable.

blocks.text: 3.3 Information received from other sources

items: Information from another Platform user, for example when a brand or creator submits an application, review, campaign invitation or communication involving you.
Information from integrated social-media or other third-party services, where you voluntarily connect such services and the relevant service permits the information to be shared.
Information from payment, verification, fraud-prevention, analytics, hosting, communications or other service providers engaged to support the Platform.

blocks.text: We process personal data for purposes connected with operating, securing and improving the Platform, including:

items: creating and administering user accounts and profiles;
facilitating discovery and matching between brands and creators;
publishing and managing campaigns and applications;
enabling communications and exchange of campaign materials;
processing, reconciling or facilitating payments and payouts, where enabled;
operating Connects, credits or other Platform functionality;
verifying accounts and preventing fraud, abuse, spam and unauthorised activity;
providing customer support and responding to requests, complaints and grievances;
maintaining security, logs, backups and technical integrity;
analysing Platform usage and improving features, recommendations and user experience;
complying with applicable law, lawful governmental requests, court orders and regulatory requirements;
protecting the rights, property, safety and security of users, the Company and others; and
carrying out corporate transactions, restructuring or business continuity activities, where applicable.

blocks.text: Tazmify may use automated rules, algorithms or recommendation technologies to help users discover relevant campaigns or creators. Matching may take account of information such as niche/category, audience or engagement information, location/proximity, campaign requirements, budget, profile information and Platform activity.

These tools are intended to support discovery and do not by themselves create a legal obligation for a user to engage with another user. Where applicable law requires additional notice, consent or safeguards for automated processing, Tazmify will provide the required information and controls.

Where a location-enabled feature is used, Tazmify may process approximate or precise location information, depending on the permission granted and the technical implementation of the feature. Location may be used to show nearby creators or campaigns, determine geographic relevance, support matching and improve location-based discovery.

Location access should be requested only when the relevant Platform feature requires it. Users may manage location permissions through their device settings, subject to the effect that disabling the permission may have on location-dependent features.

If you connect a social-media account or another third-party service to Tazmify, we may receive information that the third party makes available to us under your authorisation and its applicable terms. The information received may be used to populate or verify profile information, display permitted portfolio or audience information, support campaign matching or provide the connected feature.

Tazmify does not obtain more information from a connected service than is reasonably required for the relevant feature. Your use of the third-party service remains subject to that provider’s own privacy policy and terms.

Tazmify may process content that you voluntarily upload, transmit or publish through the Platform, including photographs, videos, documents, campaign briefs, messages, reviews and other materials. Such content may be made visible to other users where the functionality of the Platform permits it.
Users should not upload personal data belonging to another person unless they are authorised to do so and have an appropriate lawful basis or permission.

We do not sell personal data as a standalone commercial product. We may disclose or make personal data available where reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including to the following categories of recipients:

items: Other Tazmify users, where information is intended to form part of a public or user-to-user profile, campaign, application, review, communication or collaboration.

Service providers and processors supporting hosting, cloud infrastructure, databases, security, analytics, communications, customer support, verification, payment processing, payouts and other Platform operations.
Payment and financial-service providers, where required to process or facilitate a transaction or payout.
Social-media or other integrated service providers, where you choose to use an integration.
Professional advisers, auditors, insurers and other advisers where reasonably necessary for legitimate business, legal or compliance purposes.
Government authorities, courts, regulators, law-enforcement bodies or other persons where disclosure is required or permitted by applicable law or necessary to protect rights, safety or security.
Successors or counterparties in connection with a merger, acquisition, financing, restructuring, sale of assets or similar corporate transaction, subject to applicable law.

blocks.text: Third-party service providers are expected to process personal data only for authorised purposes and subject to appropriate contractual, technical or organisational safeguards, as applicable.

Where Tazmify enables campaign payments, creator payouts, Connects, premium campaigns or related transactions, transaction information may be processed by Tazmify and/or third-party payment or financial-service providers. The specific payment method, provider, fees, settlement process, refund rules and transaction terms may be governed by the applicable payment or commercial terms presented at the time of the transaction.

Tazmify will not request or retain payment-card credentials beyond what is reasonably necessary for the relevant transaction and lawful operational purposes, subject to the technical configuration of the payment service used.

Tazmify processes personal data only for specified and lawful purposes and in accordance with applicable law. Depending on the processing activity, the applicable legal basis may include your consent, performance or facilitation of a service requested by you, compliance with a legal obligation, protection of rights or security, or another ground permitted by applicable law.

Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw consent through the available Platform controls or by contacting us, subject to legal and operational limitations. Withdrawal of consent will not affect processing that has already lawfully occurred before withdrawal and may affect the availability of the relevant feature.

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 have been brought into force in phases. Tazmify will implement the statutory requirements from their respective effective dates and will update its notices and processes as required.

We retain personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, to provide the Platform, maintain business and transaction records, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, prevent fraud or abuse, maintain security, comply with legal obligations and establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

When personal data is no longer required for a lawful purpose, we will delete it, anonymise it or otherwise dispose of it in accordance with applicable law and our retention procedures. Some information may need to be retained for a longer period where required by law or where reasonably necessary for legal claims, fraud prevention, security or accounting purposes.

Backups and system logs may persist for a limited period after deletion in accordance with backup, disaster-recovery and security procedures, after which they are deleted or overwritten in the ordinary course.

Users may request deletion of their Tazmify account and associated personal data through the account-deletion functionality made available in the Platform or through the Tazmify data-deletion page: https://www.tazmify.com/data-deletion.

Deletion may be subject to lawful retention requirements, unresolved transactions, fraud-prevention requirements, legal claims, security requirements or other circumstances where applicable law permits or requires continued retention. Where retention is required, the retained information will be limited to what is necessary for that purpose and will not be retained longer than required.
Where Google Play account-deletion requirements apply, Tazmify will maintain an accessible deletion mechanism and the relevant Play Console declarations consistently with this Policy.

We use reasonable technical, organisational and administrative safeguards designed to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration or disclosure. Measures may include access controls, authentication, encryption where technically appropriate, secure development and hosting practices, monitoring, backups and incident-response procedures.

No electronic system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials and for promptly reporting suspected unauthorised access or security incidents.

The precise security controls used by Tazmify may change as the Platform develops. This Policy does not constitute a representation that every category of data is encrypted at rest or in every system unless specifically stated by Tazmify.

If a personal data breach occurs, Tazmify will assess and respond to the incident in accordance with applicable law and its incident-response procedures. Where notification to affected individuals, the Data Protection Board of India, or another authority is required, Tazmify will provide such notification within the applicable statutory framework.

Tazmify is intended for persons who are legally capable of entering into the relevant user relationship and is not intended to knowingly collect personal data from children. We do not knowingly solicit accounts from persons under 18 years of age.

If we become aware that personal data of a child has been collected contrary to applicable law, we will take reasonable steps to address the situation, including deletion where required, subject to legal obligations.

Depending on the infrastructure and service providers used by Tazmify, personal data may be processed or stored in India or another jurisdiction. Where personal data is transferred outside India, Tazmify will do so in accordance with applicable law and any restrictions, contractual safeguards or government requirements that apply to the relevant transfer.

Users should understand that data protection requirements may differ between jurisdictions. Tazmify will maintain appropriate contractual and organisational safeguards with relevant service providers, where required.

The website and Platform may use cookies, SDKs and similar technologies for authentication, security, preferences, analytics, performance measurement and feature functionality. Where required by law, consent or user controls will be provided for non-essential technologies.
Third-party analytics or SDK providers may independently process technical or usage information in accordance with their own policies and the permissions or configuration applicable to the Platform.
Subject to applicable law and its effective dates, users may have rights including:

items: to obtain information about the personal data processed about them;
to request correction, completion or updating of inaccurate or incomplete personal data;
to request erasure where retention is no longer necessary or where the law provides such a right;
to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent;
to raise a grievance concerning processing of personal data;
to nominate another individual to exercise rights in accordance with applicable law; and
to exercise any additional rights made available by applicable law.

blocks.text: To exercise a privacy right, please contact contact@tazmify.com. We may request reasonable information to verify the identity of the requester before acting on a request.

Questions, complaints or grievances concerning personal data or this Policy may be submitted to contact@tazmify.com. We will review and address complaints in accordance with applicable law and our internal grievance procedures.

If a statutory grievance mechanism, Data Protection Officer or other designated contact becomes applicable to Tazmify, the relevant details will be published or otherwise communicated as required by law.

The Platform may contain links to or integrations with third-party websites, applications, social networks, payment services or other services. Tazmify is not responsible for the privacy practices of independent third parties. Users should review the privacy notices of those services before providing information to them.

We may update this Policy to reflect changes in the Platform, technology, service providers, applicable law or our data practices. The updated version will be published on the Tazmify website and, where appropriate, communicated through the Platform. The “Last Updated” date at the beginning of this Policy will identify the latest version.
This Policy is governed by the laws of India, subject to any mandatory rights or protections that apply to a user under applicable law.

The Platform enables brands and influencers/creators to discover and connect with one another. TAZMIFY does not guarantee responses, connections, commercial relationships, outcomes, income, reach, engagement, business or continued availability of any user.

sections.heading: 13. Verification Does Not Eliminate User Responsibility
